values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica showed no price breakdown for this site on 2026-11-10 although its calendar offers the nights; the rate is the one DCNR publishes for every state forest motorized site: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('$10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents ... effective as of November 3, 2022'). The $6.50 reservation fee is the one the engine quotes on the Tuscarora State Forest site pages read the same day ('Reservation Fees: $6.50').

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('can be reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'; 'A camping permit will be valid for no more than seven consecutive nights'); site page(s) 29262 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm', 'Checkout Time: 3:00 pm', Max Reservation Window through Oct 10 2027; the calendar offered nights for Nov 17-30 2026, May 12-25 2027 and Jul 14-27 2027); the 48-hour rule is permit condition 6 on the ReserveAmerica forest page as read for the same forest system on 2026-11-10; read 2026-11-10

note: A gravel parking lot about 30 m by 25 m on Bums Inn Road, 0.15 mile from Broad Mountain Road above Upper Strasburg; the agency says it holds two camper trailers of any size, and that the access road is rough but flat. Back-in. The booking page lists 10 ft of overhead clearance. A private house sits about 70 m to the east. No picnic table or fire ring listed. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Keep. Site is live and bookable online (all nights tried open), 50 ft max vehicle length, gravel lot. Added reservation fee, booking note, pull_through false, facilities; note rewritten. Phone confirmed. One thing for the owner: the page lists overhead clearance of 10 ft.
flags: CRITERIA QUESTION (owner's call): the booking page says 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 10' (feet). A rig just under 10.5 ft tall does not clear a true 10-ft limit. Imagery (leaf-off, rendered) shows an open gravel lot with no canopy over it, and the same page allows 50-ft vehicles and '2 camper trailers of any size' (DCNR GIS), so the figure may describe branches over the access track or be a default. Not dropped; the note carries the figure.
PHONE: stored 717-485-3148 confirmed as the Buchanan district office on the DCNR Buchanan pages. No change.

Fee not quoted by the engine: ReserveAmerica showed no price breakdown for this Buchanan site though the calendar sells the nights (same as Buchanan/Tuscarora cases in the last batch). $10/$15 is from DCNR's prices page and $6.50 from the Tuscarora site pages read today; the cart needs a login and was not opened.

Winter line in the note: 'State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed' is DCNR's wording on the Tuscarora camping page; the Buchanan camping page as fetched has no winter statement. Kept as agency-wide practice; strike it if a forest-specific source is wanted.

Access: 'Access road is rough but flat' (booking page). OSRM reaches the pin over Shearer Road and 0.16 mi of unnamed track (its nearest road is 16 m from the pin). Road surface tags, weight limits and barriers: UNREAD (Overpass returned 504 / timed out).
Bear Valley brochure's 'CLOSED for Evaluation/Maintenance' overprint is on a different site (Broad Mountain Road at Clarks Knob Road), not BV001.
Pin 39.99422,-77.81242 is the site's own GIS point and sits on the gravel lot in imagery: no move. Elevation stored 619 m; USGS 3DEP reads 624.5 m. apply.py does not write elevation.
